name: Churchee
shortDescription: A Welsh church-website management system in beta, with managed cloud hosting, configurable templates and connections to church content tools.
suitableContexts: UK churches seeking a managed website platform while it remains in beta
Church teams wanting a website that pulls through content from existing tools
Churches able to accept a 36-month published contract term after checking the beta agreement

pricing.summary: Churchee publishes beta monthly prices of £30, £50 and £100, each described with a 36-month contract, cloud hosting, backups and ongoing support. Obtain the actual beta agreement, annual-payment position, termination rights, implementation scope, add-ons and any post-beta price changes in writing before committing.

startingPrice.qualifier: Small plan, published with a 36-month contract

tiers.label: Small
tiers.detail: Seven page template designs, two integrations, ongoing support, backups and Azure cloud hosting; published with a 36-month contract.

tiers.label: Medium
tiers.detail: Ten page template designs, three integrations, ongoing support, backups and Azure cloud hosting; published with a 36-month contract.

tiers.label: Large
tiers.detail: Fifteen page template designs, four integrations, ongoing support, backups and Azure cloud hosting; published with a 36-month contract.

gdprInformation: The reviewed public page describes Azure cloud hosting and backups but does not publish a product privacy notice, DPA, hosting region, sub-processor list, retention schedule, access-control model, content-export process or incident arrangements. Confirm these, along with analytics and each integration's data flow, before placing member data, form submissions or pastoral information in the service.
coreFeatures: Media management with responsive image crops
Two to four integrations depending on plan
Open-source MIT-licensed codebase according to supplier
integrations: Supplier says it can pull sermons, events and social posts from tools the church already uses; the available integrations depend on plan and are not enumerated on the reviewed page
importExport: No public content or data-export format was found; obtain an export demonstration, migration plan, ownership position and exit process before agreeing to a 36-month term
support: Supplier includes ongoing support in each published plan
Supplier says backups and cloud hosting are included

uk-operator.value: Churchee identifies Treefish Ltd in its footer. Companies House identifies Treefish Ltd, company 16400717, with a Caerphilly registered office.

website-workflow.value: Supplier describes a church website system with separate content and design management, media handling, responsive images, integrations and Azure cloud hosting.

pricing-and-beta.value: Supplier publishes £30, £50 and £100 monthly plans, each with a 36-month contract, and says Churchee is currently in beta.

editorial.assessment: Churchee is a focused UK church website product, not a general design agency service. Its public offer outlines website, media, hosting and connection options, but it remains in beta and publishes a 36-month contract. Check the contract and exit terms, and confirm which third-party tools work before relying on automated sermon, event or social-content publishing.
bestFor: Churches willing to evaluate a Welsh beta product with managed hosting and a clear published price direction
Teams that want their website to draw content from existing church tools
Churches that value a content-editor workflow separated from template and design changes
strengths: Identified UK company and church-specific product focus
Published GBP beta prices and included hosting, backups and support
Content, design and media-management workflow described
Supplier describes integration-led updates for sermons, events and social posts
limitations: No public service DPA, privacy terms, hosting-region or sub-processor detail found
Supported integrations and their data flows are not enumerated
No public content-export, cancellation or migration process found

procurementVerdict.problem: Keeping a church website current without re-entering sermons, events and social content in several places
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK church-specific website product combining managed hosting with a content-editor workflow and limited plan-based integrations
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Request the beta agreement, current integration list, DPA, hosting region, backup-and-restoration terms and a complete content export demonstration before committing to the 36-month contract
